summary.intent: Execute Phase 34 of the cipher-box project, which involved expanding E2E test coverage (media/streaming/batch-download specs + account cleanup helpers) and capturing staging performance baselines (journey timing + load tests).
summary.outcome: All 4 plans completed: shared account cleanup helper wired into 10 specs (34-01), 16 new media/streaming/preview E2E tests (34-02), 5 batch download E2E tests (34-03), and staging baselines captured with journey timing JSON saved. Load tests were throttle-limited but documented useful contention data.

repo: playwright.config.ts did not respect BASE_URL env var for overriding baseURL — had to add explicit process.env.BASE_URL override and conditional webServer block to skip localhost startup when targeting staging
Web3Auth SDK initialization on staging takes >20s, causing wallet button waitFor timeouts — journey-timing.spec.ts needed its timeout increased from 20s to 60s for staging runs
The cleanup helper (deleteAccountViaPage) was hardcoded to derive the API URL from localhost patterns, failing on staging — needed to derive the API URL dynamically from the page's current hostname
vitest does not auto-load .env files; the tests/load suite had no dotenv integration — env vars must be sourced via shell before running (e.g., `set -a; source .env; set +a`)
The SDK load test harness (tests/load) does not forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET during createTestAccount — only on re-auth — causing staging rate limiter to block 190/200 client creations
Pinata's default API endpoint is https://api.pinata.cloud; PinataProvider sends auth as Bearer token in Authorization header
BYO load test plan was committed with DEFERRED status by the 34-04 agent; needed manual update to ACTIVE after Pinata credentials were confirmed available

code.finding: Added process.env.BASE_URL override for baseURL and conditional webServer block — only starts local dev server when BASE_URL is not set to an external URL
waitFor timeout was 20_000ms — insufficient for Web3Auth staging initialization; increased to 60_000ms
deleteAccountViaPage hardcoded API URL detection based on localhost patterns; fixed to derive API URL dynamically from the current page URL hostname
No dotenv loading — vitest does not auto-load .env files; env must be sourced in shell before running tests

workflow: When multiple executor agents run in parallel on worktrees, cherry-picking commits to the phase branch requires careful STATE.md conflict resolution — each agent writes its own STATE.md updates
Stale git worktrees can leave .git/index.lock files that block subsequent operations — need explicit worktree remove + force-clean before spawning new agents on the same phase branch

The classifyHandoffIfNeeded Claude Code runtime bug can cause agents to report 'failed' even after successfully completing all work — spot-checking SUMMARY.md existence and git commits is the reliable completion signal
Browser-based Playwright load tests are fundamentally limited to ~5-10 concurrent clients on a single machine; SDK-level load tests (tests/load) are needed for 200+ concurrent user scenarios

friction: 34-04 agent spawned in a worktree; its commits needed manual cherry-picking to the phase branch — STATE.md merge conflicts on each cherry-pick
34-03 agent hit a git lock conflict because 34-02's worktree had not been cleaned up before 34-03 spawned
BASE_URL env var silently ignored by playwright.config.ts — tests appeared to target staging but were actually hitting localhost; only caught by noticing blank page in test screenshot
vitest load tests silently skipped all BYO tests (SKIPPED, not FAILED) when .env wasn't sourced — no error, just zero coverage
Staging throttle limiter blocked 190/200 SDK load test accounts because the test harness doesn't forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET during initial account creation — wasted a full test run
BYO capacity ceiling test and sustained load test ran concurrently against the same staging instance, conflating their throttle pressure
Background bash task for browser load test timed out at 10 minutes (the tool default) — had to piece together partial results from output file
open_items: SDK load test harness (tests/load/src/harness/client-pool.ts) needs to forward THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET during createTestAccount calls, not just re-auth — currently blocks high-client-count tests on staging
BYO capacity ceiling test (50→100→200→500→1000 clients) was never successfully completed — throttle limiter blocked all runs; needs the harness fix above before re-running
34-04 SUMMARY.md notes staging baselines as partial — sustained load baseline only reflects 10/200 clients due to throttle issue; should be re-run after harness fix
Pinata BYO load test results (byo-capacity-ceiling scenario) were never captured — the entire point of the BYO load test plan; blocked on throttle bypass fix
tests/load/.env is gitignored but contains Pinata credentials — team members need a documented onboarding path to populate this file for local/staging load testing
Web3Auth staging initialization latency (>20s) should be investigated — may indicate a cold-start or SDK version issue on staging that inflates login journey baseline
Phase 34 verification (gsd-verifier) was not run in the transcript — phase was not formally marked complete in ROADMAP/STATE
